name: design-audit-offer
description: After the second edit to a UI file (html, css, tsx, vue, svelte, astro and similar) in a project that has a design source (DESIGN.md, project-context/design/, .hallmark/), adds one line telling the model to offer a UI/UX audit against the design standards once. Reminder only; it never audits, never blocks and never changes the design. Reads no env.
